note: Submodule of oEmbed lazy load. Registers a youtube ProviderEnhancer (@ProviderEnhancer id: youtube, providers: {YouTube}) and adds YouTube player options as third-party settings on the lazyload_oembed field formatter via hook_field_formatter_third_party_settings_form(). The boolean options autoplay, modestbranding, enablejsapi, origin, hideinfo (deprecated), rel are stored under a formatter component's third_party_settings.oembed_lazyload_youtube.* in a bundle's entity_view_display (schema field.formatter.third_party.oembed_lazyload_youtube). No permission, route, service or config entity of its own. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config: introspection reads which YouTube option is enabled on a field; execution toggles a YouTube option on a field's lazyload_oembed formatter, verified against the live entity_view_display. Fixtures create/remove namespaced field_oly_* fields on node.article.

evals.prompt: What does the oembed_lazyload_youtube submodule add on top of oEmbed lazy load, and where do I configure YouTube player options like autoplay?
evals.expected_output: It adds a youtube ProviderEnhancer and exposes YouTube player options as third-party settings on the lazyload_oembed formatter (a 'YouTube settings' section on Manage display). Options are stored under the formatter component's third_party_settings.oembed_lazyload_youtube.*.

evals.prompt: Which YouTube player options does the oembed_lazyload_youtube module let me toggle on the lazy-load oEmbed formatter?
evals.expected_output: Boolean options: autoplay, modestbranding (hide the YouTube logo), enablejsapi (control via the IFrame API), origin (restrict IFrame API to the oEmbed iframe host, only with enablejsapi), hideinfo (deprecated), and rel (only related videos from the same channel).

evals.prompt: How does oembed_lazyload_youtube plug into the oEmbed lazy load provider-enhancer system, and what provider does its enhancer handle?
evals.expected_output: It registers a ProviderEnhancer plugin with id 'youtube' matching the 'YouTube' provider (extends ProviderEnhancerBase); it parses the video id, adds a JS library, and rewrites the iframe URL with player params based on the formatter's third-party settings.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field field_oly_known is displayed with the lazy-load oEmbed formatter and has a YouTube player option turned on. Inspect the live default view display and tell me which oembed_lazyload_youtube option is enabled.
evals.expected_output: autoplay is enabled: field_oly_known's lazyload_oembed formatter has third_party_settings.oembed_lazyload_youtube.autoplay = true.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field field_oly_mb uses the lazy-load oEmbed formatter with a YouTube branding option configured. Inspect the live view display and tell me which oembed_lazyload_youtube option is enabled (the one that hides the YouTube logo).
evals.expected_output: modestbranding is enabled: field_oly_mb's lazyload_oembed formatter has third_party_settings.oembed_lazyload_youtube.modestbranding = true (hides the YouTube logo).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field field_oly_task is displayed with the lazy-load oEmbed formatter but its YouTube autoplay option is off. Using oembed_lazyload_youtube, enable autoplay for this field's YouTube embeds, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_oly_task lazyload_oembed formatter's third_party_settings.oembed_lazyload_youtube.autoplay to TRUE in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default and save (e.g. load the display, edit the component's third_party_settings, setComponent + save).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article field field_oly_rel uses the lazy-load oEmbed formatter. Configure its YouTube embeds so that related videos are limited to the same channel (enable the oembed_lazyload_youtube 'rel' option), and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_oly_rel lazyload_oembed formatter's third_party_settings.oembed_lazyload_youtube.rel to TRUE in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default and save.
